```{r}
#| label: primaer-sekundaer
#| echo: false

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph primaer_sekundaer {
  graph [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    bgcolor = 'transparent'
    nodesep = 0.8
    ranksep = 0.9
    label = 'Biologisch primäres vs. sekundäres Wissen\\nWarum Schulen existieren: Sekundäres Wissen erfordert bewusste Instruktion'
    labelloc = t
    fontsize = 14
    fontcolor = '#666666'
  ]

  node [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 12
    style = 'filled,rounded'
    fontcolor = 'white'
    penwidth = 0
    shape = box
    margin = '0.25,0.15'
  ]

  edge [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 10
    arrowsize = 0.8
  ]

  origin [
    label = 'Menschliche Fähigkeiten'
    fillcolor = '#64748b'
    fontsize = 14
  ]

  primary [
    label = 'Biologisch primär'
    fillcolor = '#0072B2'
    fontsize = 13
  ]

  secondary [
    label = 'Biologisch sekundär'
    fillcolor = '#D55E00'
    fontsize = 13
  ]

  p_examples [
    label = 'Sprechen\\nGesichtserkennung\\nSoziale Interaktion'
    fillcolor = '#56B4E9'
    fontsize = 11
  ]

  s_examples [
    label = 'Lesen & Schreiben\\nMathematik\\nProgrammieren'
    fillcolor = '#E69F00'
    fontcolor = '#222222'
    fontsize = 11
  ]

  p_how [
    label = 'Entwickelt sich\\nnatürlich'
    fillcolor = '#dce8f5'
    fontcolor = '#0072B2'
    style = 'filled'
    shape = plaintext
    fontsize = 11
  ]

  s_how [
    label = 'Erfordert bewusste\\nInstruktion & Übung'
    fillcolor = '#fde8d8'
    fontcolor = '#D55E00'
    style = 'filled'
    shape = plaintext
    fontsize = 11
  ]

  barrier [
    label = 'Kein Selbstläufer!\\nKI-Outsourcing umgeht\\ndiesen notwendigen Prozess'
    fillcolor = '#F5F5F5'
    fontcolor = '#9A4665'
    style = 'filled'
    shape = plaintext
    fontsize = 11
  ]

  origin -> primary [label = '  Evolution  ' color = '#0072B2']
  origin -> secondary [label = '  Kultur  ' color = '#D55E00']

  primary -> p_examples [color = '#0072B2']
  secondary -> s_examples [color = '#D55E00']

  primary -> p_how [color = '#0072B2' style = dashed]
  secondary -> s_how [color = '#D55E00' style = dashed]

  s_how -> barrier [color = '#9A4665' style = dashed]

  {rank = same; primary; secondary}
  {rank = same; p_examples; s_examples}
  {rank = same; p_how; s_how}
}
")
```
